summary.en: A huge number counts up at the left while one more cell of rings appears round the anchor per counted step; reversed out of ink by default.
summary.zh: 左边一个大数字往上数，每数一步锚点周围多一个圆环细胞；默认墨底反白。

fits: A small count that matters (voices, regions, models), at most sixteen steps.
notFor: Large numbers or percentages (use a counter brick); counts that are not units.

intent.en: A small count is felt as things appearing: one cell per step round the anchor while the number climbs.
intent.zh: 小计数被感受为东西一件件出现：数字往上走，锚点周围每一步多一个细胞。

content.en: A value and its start (difference ≤ 16), a line (≤ 32 / 16 字), an optional label (≤ 30 / 16 字).
content.zh: 数值与起点（差 ≤ 16），一行字（≤ 32 字符 / 16 字），可选标签（≤ 30 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 一个要紧的小计数（声部、地区、模型），最多 16 步。

notFor.zh: 大数或百分比（用计数器积木）；不是单位的计数。

en: At most four values a beat; faster and the in-between values flash unreadably.
zh: 每拍最多四个值；再快中间值会闪得读不出来。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
